sc: The Boots of Spades are a feet slot cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the King and Queen of Spades Pack.

sc: It can be made at level 80 Crafting by combining an anima core helm of Seren with 1 of each of the essences - Serenic, Sliskean, Zamorakian, and Zarosian - after the ability to craft refined anima core of Seren armour has been unlocked by earning 750 Serenist reputation.

sc: It can be made by using a piece of sacred clay class 2 on a creation kiln.

The roseblood robe top is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
When obtained, it is automatically converted into 500 charges within Wythien's enhancer management interface, where the effect can be toggled on or off.
Any enhancers mistakenly obtained cannot be used - the only action available is to convert them into charges (or destroy).

The Santa hat with beard is an item created by combining a Santa hat with a Santa beard.
